events.title: The Silent Gate
events.description: An ancient stone gate blocks your path. Strange symbols cover its surface.

choices.result: You discover an ancient warning: The forest remembers every visitor.
The gate moves slightly, revealing a faded symbol of the moon.
choices.evidence: A faded moon symbol marks the entrance.

choices.result: A faint voice whispers: Those who seek the truth must observe before they act.

events.title: The Watcher's Bargain
events.description: A hooded Watcher appears beside the gate. 'Why have you entered the forest?' the figure asks.

choices.result: The Watcher nods. 'Then seek the truth hidden in the forgotten chronicle.'
choices.evidence: The forgotten chronicle contains the forest's truth.

choices.result: The Watcher steps aside, but warns you that false paths lead deeper into the forest.

events.title: A Voice in the Mist

The marks guide you safely through the mist. You discover that the symbols point toward an ancient tower.

events.title: The Last Passage
events.description: You reach a towering archway at the forest's edge. The path ahead is uncertain, and the forest's final test begins.
